comparison.objective: Free a fused print-in-place hinge without breaking it; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated sub-breakage rocking to overcome adhesion versus coaxial tool use and reaction-counterholding during locknut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Leaf reaches 120° and passes a low-force free-motion test; candidate returns to 90° through three cycles with the setting locked.
comparison.reason: The indexed record has no task.json/spec versions, but its complete PR body defines a break-free rocking test that is meaningfully different from setting retention.
